title: SQL BETWEEN Operator
text:
SQL
BETWEEN
Operator



The SQL BETWEEN Operator

The
BETWEEN
operator is used in the
WHERE
clause to select values within a specified range.

The range is
inclusive
- the beginning and end values of the range are included in the results.

The values can be numbers, text, or dates.

Syntax

SELECT
column_name(s)
FROM
table_name
WHERE
column_name
BETWEEN
value1
AND
value2;
